name: Agent Receivable Report
query:
SELECT
    si.name AS "Invoice No:Link/Sales Invoice:120",
    si.posting_date AS "Posting Date:Date:100",
    si.due_date AS "Due Date:Date:100",
    si.customer AS "Customer:Link/Customer:200",
    si.customer_name AS "Customer Name::200",
    si.grand_total AS "Invoice Amount:Currency:120",
    si.outstanding_amount AS "Outstanding Amount:Currency:120",
    IFNULL(SUM(per.allocated_amount), 0) AS "Paid Amount:Currency:120",
    (si.outstanding_amount - IFNULL(SUM(per.allocated_amount), 0)) AS "Net Outstanding:Currency:120",
    CASE
        WHEN si.outstanding_amount > 0 AND si.due_date < CURDATE() THEN "Overdue"
        ELSE "Not Overdue"
    END AS "Status::120"
FROM
    `tabSales Invoice` si
LEFT JOIN
    `tabPayment Entry Reference` per ON per.reference_name = si.name
LEFT JOIN
    `tabPayment Entry` pe ON pe.name = per.parent AND pe.docstatus = 1
WHERE
    si.docstatus = 1
GROUP BY
    si.name
ORDER BY
    si.posting_date DESC, si.customer ASC;
